items.name: DSI Project — AI-Powered Data Intelligence Platform
items.summary: Research collaboration with {{rizoiu}} (UTS), building an end-to-end pipeline that collects public social media data at scale, analyses discourse trends, and republishes AI-tagged content to a third-party platform.
bullets: Developed and maintained data collectors targeting major social media platforms to extract content signals, trending keywords, and engagement metrics at scale.
Aggregated and analysed topic trends over time to surface insights into evolving discourse patterns.

Phase 2: integrated with a third-party publishing platform to automate an end-to-end pipeline — ingesting native data, applying AI-driven tagging and categorisation, and republishing enriched content programmatically.

items.name: WV-Tech Phase 2 — GPU Memory Erasure & Integration
items.summary: Extended the data-wiping platform with NVIDIA VRAM erasure, embedding custom GPU drivers into a bootable ISO and validating against IEEE data-erasure standards with external certification partner Viden.
bullets: Researched and implemented VRAM read/write erasure for NVIDIA graphics cards, with dynamic adaptation across different GPU and motherboard vendors.
Embedded pre-configured GPU drivers directly into a custom ISO image for seamless deployment across target hardware environments.
Liaised with external partner Viden — provided technical support for performance testing, IEEE data-erasure standard validation, and formal certification verification.

items.name: Salesforce CRM Platform — Development & Administration
items.summary: CRM development and administration for UTS Rapido's internal operations — building Apex automations, LWC components, and data integrity systems to support cross-team reporting.
bullets: Implemented bidirectional Grant Type field synchronisation between Opportunity and Campaign objects using Record-Triggered Flows and Global Value Sets.
Built Campaign-Opportunity data integrity systems and resolved relationship issues affecting cross-team reporting pipelines.
Configured SDG multi-select picklist integration, ANZSIC classification fields, and role hierarchy access controls.

items.name: UTS Working Planning Tool
items.summary: Internal workload-planning web app for the UTS People Unit, used by staff across the university. Joined mid-project to accelerate frontend delivery in React and TypeScript.
bullets: Joined an in-flight project and quickly ramped up on the existing React and TypeScript codebase.
Built and extended features across the app's routing, context providers, and component architecture.
Implemented responsive layouts for consistent use across desktop and mobile devices.
Helped the team deliver the tool to UTS staff on schedule.

items.name: WV-Tech — Comprehensive Data Wiping Software
items.summary: Cross-platform desktop application for secure hardware data erasure, combining an Electron/React frontend with a Bash backend for BIOS interrogation, hardware reporting, and automated PDF output.
bullets: Led project direction in sync with client needs; guided team to ensure timely milestone delivery.
Built a secure data-wiping backend including BIOS interrogation and battery reporting capabilities.
Designed an intuitive Electron React interface communicating fluidly with the bash backend.
Enabled auto-generation of detailed hardware reports with consolidated PDF output and asset tag removal.

items.name: Quantum Project — Embedded Deployment & Fleet Updates
items.summary: Took over an existing project and deployed it onto single-board computers for clients TheQ and {{devitt}} (UTS Centre for Quantum Software and Information), building a containerised runtime with automatic over-the-network updates across all devices.
bullets: Evaluated Banana Pi, Raspberry Pi and Radxa CM3 boards, selecting Banana Pi for software compatibility and long-term hardware availability.
Flashed and tuned Ubuntu images, optimising system services and setting up service management on a minimal image that shipped without systemctl, so application processes start automatically on boot.
Packaged the application as a Docker image running on each board for consistent, reproducible deployments.
Built a network-based update mechanism that automatically checks for new image versions and rolls out updates across the entire device fleet.

items.name: Navantia Digital Twin Phase 2 — Distributed Processing System
items.summary: Second phase of the Navantia digital twin work — scaled the data-processing pipeline into an event-driven distributed system, with a master node dispatching work to worker machines over a LAN bridge via Celery.
bullets: Deployed a watcher on the master node that monitors incoming ocean and weather data and automatically triggers processing when new data arrives.
Automatically split each new dataset and created Celery workers to distribute sub-tasks across networked worker machines for parallel computation.
Collected and merged worker outputs on the master node once all sub-tasks completed, producing the final result dataset.

items.name: Navantia Digital Twin
items.summary: Internship on a defence maritime digital twin project that simulates voyage routes against one-month ocean current and weather forecasts to reduce fuel consumption and improve safety at sea. Built the data-processing layer around the simulation engine.
bullets: Built Python and pandas scripts to clean and restructure incoming ocean current and weather data.
Split datasets into computation units for Navantia's proprietary simulation engine.
Merged the engine's partial outputs and computed the final result dataset.
